entities.name: Rapperswil–Ziegelbrücke railway line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Rapperswil–Ziegelbrücke railway line is a single-track standard-gauge railway line in Switzerland. It was built as part of the route from Rüti to Glarus, which was opened by the United Swiss Railways on 15 February 1859.
